title: Category:Quests
html:
Quests help to make the game interesting. This page shows the various categories of quests. There is a category page for each dungeon, as well as a few special category pages. To find a particular quest, go to the appropriate category page, or enter the name of the quest in the search box to the left.

Completing a quest will gain a modifier called "15% More Cowbell" for 5 minutes. This modifier increases the experience gained from killing monsters by 15%. The duration of this modifier can stack up to 5 times for a total of 30 minutes of 15% extra experience. The duration of this modifier does not elapse in town and the modifier is lost if your character dies.

Many quests require finding some sort of item or items. The Quest Items List details many of these items.

A special category of quests are Relic Quests, which involve finding ancient relics in special chests, often protected by a Chest Guardian. These relics can be exchanged for King's Coins at the bank.
